Name: MAP_DEFAULT_INFO_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-map defaults: fast travel, AI sight, weather, sound, player light and collision switching. The row ID is the map ID as a number (m10_00_00_00 → 10000000, m60_40_56_00 → 60405600). For overworld tiles the active world-state variant of the tile is tried first, then the base tile. Several values can be overridden by the map region the player stands in.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game (retail sets it on most rows, which work normally).
Padding.
Padding.

Fields.Name: Enable Fast Travel Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Fast travel from this map is allowed only while this event flag is on. 0: always allowed. A map region's own flag takes precedence. Retail: set on catacombs, caves and other dungeons (usually the dungeon's boss-defeated flag).

Fields.Name: Weather Lot Time Offset
Fields.Description: Offset of this map's weather lottery timing, in in-game seconds. Retail: 0, except two Weeping Peninsula tiles (2400, 3600).

Fields.Name: Weather Create Asset Limit ID
Fields.Description: Limit group for assets spawned by weather on this map, passed to the weather asset spawner. -1: none. A map region's value (0 or more) takes precedence.

Fields.Name: AI Sight Type
Fields.Description: Which GameSystemCommonParam multiplier scales enemy sight on this map: 0 = the time-of-day multiplier (Morning … Midnight), 1/2/3 = the sunless Light/Dark/Very Dark multiplier. A character-level override takes precedence. Retail: 1 on legacy dungeons, 2 on catacombs, 3 on tunnels.

Fields.Name: Sound Indoor Type
Fields.Description: 1: the map counts as indoors for sound. 0: outdoors. Retail: 1 on underground maps (Ainsel River and others).

Fields.Name: Reverb Default Type
Fields.Description: Default reverb type of the map's sound. -1: none.

Fields.Name: BGM Place
Fields.Description: Default BGM place of the map. 999: keep the current BGM place (in m61 maps, 999 becomes 50).

Fields.Name: Ambient Sound Place
Fields.Description: Default ambient-sound place of the map. In m61 maps, 999 becomes 50.

Fields.Name: Map Additional Sound Bank ID
Fields.Description: Extra sound bank loaded with the map. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Map Height Info for Sound
Fields.Description: Reference height of the map for sound, in m. Retail: 0, except Stormveil Castle (-273).

Fields.Name: Blend Time-of-Day Environment Maps
Fields.Description: On: the map's environment maps blend between time zones. Off: only the first time zone's environment map is used (less GPU load and memory). Legacy maps only (m00–m49); overworld tiles always blend. No row: on.

Fields.Name: Override GI Resolution - XSS
Fields.Description: Global illumination resolution override for Xbox Series S. Appears unused by the game (PC).

Fields.Name: Hi/Lo Collision Switch - Box Width
Fields.Description: Width (X and Z) of the box used to switch between the map's high and low collision, in m. No row: 40.

Fields.Name: Hi/Lo Collision Switch - Box Height
Fields.Description: Height (Y) of the box used to switch between the map's high and low collision, in m. No row: 40.

Fields.Name: Hi/Lo Collision Switch - Margin
Fields.Description: Margin of the collision switch box, in m: the game uses an inner box (size minus the margin on each side) and an outer box (size plus the margin), so the switch doesn't flicker at the edge. Keep it smaller than half the box size. No row: 5.

Fields.Name: Automatic Draw Group - Back Side Pixel Count
Fields.Description: Pixel count for back-face tests in the automatic draw-group calculation. Appears unused by the game (retail: 32400, four legacy dungeons higher).

Fields.Name: Player Light Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the light carried by the player and Torrent on this map. A map region's value (0 or more) takes precedence. No row: 1. Retail: 1.2 on catacombs, 1.6 on some caves.

Fields.Name: Time-of-Day Player Light Scale
Fields.Description: On: the player light scale also changes with the time of day on this map. A map region can force it on or off. No row: off. Retail: on everywhere.

Fields.Name: Disable Automatic Cliff Wind
Fields.Description: On: no automatic cliff-wind sound on this map.

Fields.Name: Open Character Activation Threshold
Fields.Description: Evaluation threshold of the open-field character activation limit, used when no region in range sets one. -1: none (retail).

Fields.Name: Map Mimicry Establishment Param ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: Mimic's Veil picks its MapMimicryEstablishmentParam row from the current region's Boss Area ID instead. Retail: -1.

Fields.Name: Override GI Resolution - XSX
Fields.Description: Global illumination resolution override for Xbox Series X. Appears unused by the game (PC).
